patterns.message: mock-gohub is a standalone fake supplier, not a library. Production code talks to it over HTTP by setting GOHUB_BASE_URL, exactly as it talks to the real API. Importing it would compile supplier fixtures into the app.

apps/web and apps/ops must never import @domner/supplier. GoHub authorises by IP whitelist and the credentials live only on the worker VM; bundling the supplier client into a Vercel app puts a spendable prepaid balance behind a leakable environment variable. Enqueue work by writing to Postgres and let the worker pick it up.
mock-gohub is a standalone fake supplier, not a library. Talk to it over HTTP via GOHUB_BASE_URL.
packages/core is shared by all three apps. It must not import from any app, nor from @domner/supplier.
